noise_arms.is: the SAME live page screenshotted a second time — no reload, no new context
a reload in a new browser context in the same browser process
a second chromium process — the CI-vs-laptop case, minus the OS change
served from a second HTTP server on a different port — a Go binary and the mockup harness are never the same port

markup round-tripped through the DOM serializer — normalized attribute quoting, entity encoding and boolean attributes, which is exactly what html/template output differs from hand-written HTML by (dec-0012)

signal_arms.is: body type moved by half a pixel (--t-body: 16.5px -> 17px)
the card hairline removed (.card border-color -> transparent)
body ink set one step lighter (--ink takes the value of --ink-mid) in both schemes
one component hue wrong with no reflow (.chip-id colour -> --ink-mid)
card radius off by 2px (--r-card: 7px -> 5px) — four corners, no reflow
one token hex off by 2/255 in a single channel (--ink), both schemes — a copy-paste typo, quiet per pixel and everywhere at once
a stepped opacity off by one hundredth (.stage.next: .58 -> .57) — quiet per pixel over a large area, and covered by no other gate

info_arms.is: glyph rasterization changed with no layout change (-webkit-font-smoothing: auto) — a stand-in for a different machine's text renderer
the Palatino stack falls through to the generic serif, which is what a stock Linux install actually renders (DESIGN.md, "where that reasoning currently FAILS")
